body:
Welcome back. Read broadcast f148a27f first: the throughput ruling (risk-scaled review, 2-round cap, the advisor now clears merge holds).

Dispositions:
- #2603 (BUG-1995): the ADVISOR is merging it. The approval is at 3fe10217a2; I update-branched it to bff275bbd7 (base-only) and CI is running. Record your approval verdict when convenient. Don't merge it yourself.
- #2600 (TASK-1740, test-only, FASTTRACK): Build red only on an unrelated aida-core flake (cached_git_backend reader_ancestor_check_timeout, filed BUG-2127). I re-ran the failed jobs. When green: one light review (B1 and B2 from r1 resolved? test not flaky?) → APPROVE → mail me `HOLD READY: #2600` (label-only hold) and I clear it and merge.
- #2611 (BUG-2014): yours to record and merge (I launched it). It is DIRTY again; update from main first.
- #2617 (TASK-1746, docs, FASTTRACK): approved at 090e58033e. Record, update from main, and merge it (I dispatched it, so I can't).
- #2602 (BUG-1998): now CONFLICTS with main in history_cache.rs (from #2601). Your B3 fix-forward should resolve the conflict too. The merge resolution is not base-only, so the fresh reviewer checks the resolution plus B3. Its r3 is the last round under the cap.
- #2614 (STORY-1687): the operator chose the narrow fix (B1+B2); Codex is running it. ONE fresh STRICT review of that delta only. A new blocker → park and mail me; no round 6.
- #2619 / #2620: back with the agy factory; it picks up REQUEST CHANGES from the PR. When it re-pushes, the review counts as round 2 and is the last.
- #2541 / #2606: holds cite stale heads; re-review the current heads. Under the cap, this is their last round.

Merge order once green: 2617 (docs, low risk) → 2611 → others. Re-check main between merges.
subject: ADVISOR 08:58: dispositions under the throughput ruling + hold authority
